guidance.statement: EBIT percentage will be between Q1 and Q2 in Q3, and improve in Q4.
guidance.quote: So we expect Q3, in terms of EBIT percentage, somewhere between Q1 and Q2... And on an annualized basis from next year onwards, we should see further improvement.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Polycarbonate resin plant commissioning remains in line with FY29 number.
guidance.quote: So we continue to remain in line with our FY29 number.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Capex is expected to be about INR 240 crore this year and INR 400-420 crore next year.
guidance.quote: So there, I would expect about another INR 240 crore is what we're seeing this year. And if I was to look at next year, it would be roughly in the range of about INR 400 crore, INR 420 crore.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Targeting 14% to 15% EBIT next year with steady-state assets.
guidance.quote: we should be targeting something along the lines of about 14% to 15% EBIT.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Second half capex is expected around INR 800 crore to INR 900 crore.
guidance.quote: So around INR 800 crore to INR 900 crore further in the second half.
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

guidance.statement: Detailing future yearly capex amounts.
guidance.quote: INR 2,200 crore-INR 2,400 crore next year, INR 2,500 crore in the second year, that is FY 2028- 2029, and balance in the third year, which will be in the range of INR 2,500 crore-INR 3,000 crore.
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

guidance.statement: The company expects to spend INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore further this year.
guidance.quote: Further this year, we'll spend around another INR 1,000 crore to INR 1,500 crore this year further.
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

guidance.statement: Capital expenditure further this year will be around INR 1,500 crore to INR 1,600 crore.
guidance.quote: Further, this year, it will be around INR 1,500 crore to INR 1,600 crore.
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

guidance.statement: Planned capital expenditure for 2027 and 2028 is another INR 3,000 crore.
guidance.quote: Plus further, whatever we are going to spend in 2027, 2028 will be another INR 3,000 crore.
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

guidance.statement: Management expects a stronger margin profile for the standalone business in FY27 compared to FY26.
guidance.quote: Therefore, in FY27, we expect a stronger margin profile, even for the standalone business, compared with FY26.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Management anticipates an improvement in margins and gross numbers moving into FY27.
guidance.quote: we do anticipate an improvement in the margins as well as the gross numbers as we progress into FY27.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: The project is expected to be commissioned by June 2028.
guidance.quote: we are expecting it to be commissioned by June 2028.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: The total announced project capex is around INR11,000 crore.
guidance.quote: So, the total project, what we have announced is around INR11,000 crore.
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

guidance.statement: Management expects margins to normalize and Q4 FY26 to be better than Q3 FY26.
guidance.quote: I definitely expect Q4 FY26 to be better than Q3 FY26.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Nitric acid, nitration, and hydrogenation assets are expected to run at 100% or close to it from Q4 FY26.
guidance.quote: on the nitric acid investment, on the nitration and on the hydrogenation, we are expecting to run at 100% or close enough to 100% utilization from this quarter onwards.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Photochemical, chlorination, and fluorination utilizations are expected to pick up in Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: When we are referring to photochemical, chlorination and fluorination, that we expect those utilizations to pick up in Q1 FY27.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: MIBK will have a phased ramp-up in Q1 FY27.
guidance.quote: When we talk about MIBK, it will have a ramp-up in Q1 FY27 in a phased manner
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: High-pressure alkylation asset will come in between June and July 2026 and ramp up over 2 to 3 months.
guidance.quote: high-pressure alkylation asset, which will come in around between June and July 2026, that will have a ramp-up over two to three months
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Polycarbonate resins asset is planned to come online over the next 2 to 2.5 years.
guidance.quote: we are planning on coming online with this asset over the next 2, 2.5 years in an integrated fashion
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Q4 FY26 performance will improve, and Q1 FY27 will continue in a positive direction.
guidance.quote: Q4 FY26 would be better than Q3 FY26... Q1 FY27 will be continue in that positive direction. Q4 FY26 will be better, but Q1 FY27 will be better still.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Spending of around INR 100 crore brings the total to approximately INR 1,200 to 1,300 crore.
guidance.quote: would involve spending of around INR 100 crore, bringing the total to approximately INR 1,200–1,300 crore.
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

guidance.statement: Upstream integration assets are expected to be fully operational in Q4 FY26.
guidance.quote: upstream integration assets, which are expected to be fully operational in Q4 FY26.
guidance.speaker: Maulik Mehta

guidance.statement: Fixed costs will reduce going forward.
guidance.quote: Going forward, there will be reduction in the fixed cost over and above whatever we have achieved so far.
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

guidance.statement: Capex outlay will be around INR 3,000 crore to INR 4,000 crore for the next 3 years.
guidance.quote: You want the CAPEX outlay for next 3 years. It will be around INR 3,000 crore to INR 4,000 crore.
guidance.speaker: Sanjay Upadhyay

narrative_vs_numbers.management_says: Management consistently guided for better operational performance and margin recovery in Q4 FY26 and into FY27.
narrative_vs_numbers.numbers_say: Operating Profit and OPM % showed clear sequential improvements from Dec 2025 through Sep 2026.

promises.credibility: Management has delivered on near-term margin and operational guidance provided over the past year, though longer-term capex and capacity timelines remain pending.

bull: Latest quarter Sep 2026 delivered massive growth with revenue up 62% YoY and PAT up 234% according to the facts.
Margin improved significantly in the latest quarter Sep 2026, reaching 20.4% which is a 9.7pp YoY increase.
Management successfully delivered on past EBITDA margin guidance, showing positive progression from Dec 2025 operating profit of 211.0 to Jun 2026 operating profit of 540.0.
bear: Long-term growth is slowing significantly, showing a revenue CAGR of 13% over 5 years dropping to -0% over 3 years.
Debt to equity has increased to 0.27 compared to 0.06 three periods ago, alongside a stretching cash conversion cycle from 77 to 92 days.
Free cash flow over 5 years is negative at ₹-114 Cr, and was negative in 2 out of 5 years.
